root_cause.text: In tegra_adma_stop(), called from tegra_adma_terminate_all(), the DMA descriptor is freed via kfree() without synchronizing with the pending vchan completion tasklet, causing a use-after-free when the tasklet later accesses the freed memory.
root_cause.evidence: The commit description states: "the DMA buffer is freed by tegra_adma_terminate_all() before the vchan completion tasklet finishes accessing it." The patch replaces kfree(tdc->desc) with vchan_terminate_vdesc() and adds tegra_adma_synchronize() calling vchan_synchronize() to properly kill pending tasklets and free terminated descriptors.

When tegra_adma_terminate_all() calls tegra_adma_stop(), the descriptor is freed, but the tasklet may still be running and later access the freed memory, leading to a use-after-free.

bic_trace_step.reason: In tegra_adma_stop() (line ~461-469), the descriptor is freed via kfree(tdc->desc) without any synchronization with the pending vchan completion tasklet. In tegra_adma_terminate_all(), tegra_adma_stop() is called under spin_lock but the tasklet may still be scheduled and access the freed descriptor after the lock is released. No call to vchan_synchronize() or similar exists. This matches the root cause: use-after-free due to missing synchronization.
